subject.title: [Feature]: Support for sandbox Docker parameters (--gpus all, --ipc=host)

question: Should OpenClaw support host IPC for Docker sandboxes, and if so should it be a narrow audited `sandbox.docker.ipc` field rather than raw Docker flag passthrough?
rationale: Host IPC changes the sandbox namespace boundary and public config contract, so automation cannot safely decide the permanent policy or acceptable API shape.

options.title: Approve narrow audited IPC
options.body: Add a typed opt-in IPC setting with dangerous-mode docs, validation, security-audit findings, and focused Docker argument tests.

options.title: Reject host IPC in core
options.body: Keep sandbox isolation stricter and tell users to use a custom external runtime path for workloads that require host IPC.

options.title: Defer behind broader sandbox design
options.body: Leave the issue open until sandbox privilege knobs such as IPC, capabilities, and namespace joins get a shared policy.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow audited IPC
recommendation.body: Add a typed opt-in IPC setting with dangerous-mode docs, validation, security-audit findings, and focused Docker argument tests.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the affected sandbox and security paths to this team, and the open question is explicitly about sandbox boundary policy.
